_status: Documented from the submitted SIT723 thesis only. Appendix B describes the baseline approach; Table 4 gives per-case scores out of 35. Verbatim baseline response text was not preserved (Appendix E logged the six AI models only). Do not treat baseline_text as recoverable from this repo.
source: SIT723 submitted thesis — Appendix B (approach), Table 4 (per-case scores /35)
